topic: What power allocation trade-offs arise from differing scan losses between quasi-TEM and quasi-TE1 modes for multi-beam satellite systems?
consensus_response: The differing scan losses between quasi-TEM and quasi-TE1 modes lead to power allocation trade-offs due to variations in array factor directivity. Quasi-TEM mode's lower scan loss results in increased inter-beam interference, while quasi-TE1 mode reduces inter-beam interference but decreases signal strength. This trade-off affects system capacity and performance, requiring flexible resource management to optimize power allocation for high-gain beams and low-gain beams across varying frequency bands.
